name: David Almeling
tagline: Top rated Intellectual Property attorney in San Francisco, California
about: David Almeling is an attorney who represents clients in the San Francisco, California area. David Almeling is recognized by peers and was selected to Rising Stars for 2013 - 2019. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

David Almeling chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended Duke University School of Law and graduated in 2004. David Almeling passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 2004.
He represents clients with Intellectual Property issues in California. He also represents clients with Intellectual Property Litigation issues.

Being selected to Rising Stars is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Rising Stars, David Almeling has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
